gold: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type

selector.rationale: Lymphoma best explains the findings of atypical mononuclear cells, lymphadenopathy, and systemic symptoms like fevers and night sweats, with the highest score and most supporting evidence

rejected.label: Pyomyositis
rejected.why: lack of improvement with antibiotics and biopsy not consistent with cellulitis or pyomyositis

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: less specific findings and lower score compared to Lymphoma

rejected.label: Histiocytosis
rejected.why: limited supporting evidence and lower score

rejected.label: Leukemia
rejected.why: while it has a high score, the specific findings of atypical mononuclear cells and lymphadenopathy are more characteristic of Lymphoma
